notes: - **The shared foundation for the three charting specs**: the screener's expression DSL now has a SERIES-valued sibling (`expr-series.js`) that evaluates over a bar array. Identifiers bind to OHLCV (`open/high/low/close/volume/hlc3/ohlc4/time`); windowed builtins `sma/ema/wma/highest/lowest/stdev/sum/slope(x,n)`, `ref(x,k)`, `crossover/crossunder`, `barssince(cond)` join `abs/log/sqrt/min/max`; scalars broadcast against series; results are null-padded and null-poisoning.
